svg.title: The three modes
svg.desc: The same circuit drawn three times with the switch in Direct, Off and Reactive. In Direct the bleed joins the signal rail BUS directly. In Off the bleed branch is open and the tone path is highlighted. In Reactive the bleed joins the tone pot CW end.
svg.text: The bleed goes straight to the signal, like a regular treble bleed.
The glow marks the bleed path.
The bleed is disconnected, and the tone knob works like any tone knob.
The glow shows the tone path, which works the same in every mode.
The bleed is fed through the tone pot, so rolling the tone back eases the bleed off.
The glow marks the bleed path.
